name: ocean-drive-fpv
invariants: no ped.js or traffic.js (NPCs live in js/world/miami/crowd.js)
no rng/rng2/rng3/rng4 draws in new modules — hash01 only
no ShaderMaterial in bayWater.js; MeshPhysicalMaterial only
Pages deploys from origin/main — merge to main, do not open PRs
travel lanes TRAVEL_Z0=40.2 TRAVEL_Z1=47.8 stay empty of solids and NPC colliders
NPCs have no colliders — visual only
do not restack leftoverLot A–H cells; new RESERVED must sit west of x=240
do not consume layout rng streams
goal: Fully fleshed FPV map of Ocean Drive with NPCs (walk, bike, skate, beach, swim), fly-through obstacles, real landmarks placed on the 57.6 facade plane, then expand inland. Continuous build/test/merge loop.

phases.title: 2D Ocean Drive site plan is source of truth
phases.notes: assets/catalog/miami-ocean-drive-plan.json baked via sitePlan.js

phases.title: NPCs: walk, bike, skate, beach, swim

Clevelander-style open-air hotel at x=60 plus Cardozo-style deco at x=115
Extra promenade fly-through arches on the boardwalk

phases.title: Thicker crowd, parked bikes at racks, volleyball players, lifeguard sitters

Pedestrian mall analogue inland of Ocean Drive (z~120) with fly-under pergolas, west of leftoverLot A
Second N-S street west of Ocean Drive with painted lanes, parked cars, and one fly-under arcade
Signed rooftop AC gaps and billboard rings as extra FPV whoops, hash01, no rng burn
